lines.trans: Qing! Hao! What brings our courtyard crew up to the clock tower square?
We are following thirty-year-old map clues from a tin box under our courtyard tree!
You arrived at the exact right minute, big brother—watch the tall clock hands above.

words.gloss: needle (of a compass); hand (of a clock)

lines.trans: One minute to twelve... listen, there goes the first deep bronze chime!
Card Two says: Stand where the noon shadow touches a stone star on the ground.

words.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

lines.trans: Follow the dark tip of the tower shadow across the paving stones with me!
Right here beside the lamppost base—someone carved a small four-point star!

words.gloss: measure word for small round things

lines.trans: And look at the arrow on the longest point of the star—it aims back south!

words.gloss: measure word for small round things

Let us collect Manager Zhou and Teacher Song—the bookshop arch is only four minutes away!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū diàn. Combines 书 ('book') + 店 ('shop'); measure word: 家 (jiā).

examples.text: 原来只是隔壁书店的老板顺路帮我们送信。
examples.trans: It turned out to be only the bookshop owner next door dropping off our mail.

examples.text: 梧桐巷转角那家老书店每天下午都飘着茶香。
examples.trans: The old bookshop on the corner of Wutong Lane smells of tea every afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èrshǒu.

examples.text: 他买了一辆二手自行车。
examples.trans: He bought a secondhand bicycle.

examples.text: 我不介意穿二手衣服。
examples.trans: I don't mind wearing secondhand clothes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dīchén.

examples.text: 外面乌云密布，天空很低沉。
examples.trans: It is heavily overcast outside, and the sky is very low and gloomy.

examples.text: 他的声音变得非常低沉。
examples.trans: His voice became very deep and low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五分钟 ('five minutes').

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè. Used as a verb for carving wood/stone (刻着) or noun/classifier for 15 minutes (一刻).

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 木头盒上刻着他的名字。
examples.trans: His name is carved onto the wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí èr. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 二 ('two').

examples.text: 阳光房里一共可以摆十二把木椅。
examples.trans: Twelve wooden chairs in all can be arranged in the sunroom.

examples.text: 一年有十二个月。
examples.trans: There are twelve months in a year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán.

examples.text: 大雁在秋天向南飞。
examples.trans: Wild geese fly south in autumn.

examples.text: 我们住在城市的南边。
examples.trans: We live in the southern part of the city.

meanings.note: Small paper card for notes, gifts, or study.

examples.text: 礼物盒里放着一张小卡片。
examples.trans: Inside the gift box sits a small card.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了几句祝福。
examples.trans: He wrote a few wishes on the card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ yào. Pairs with 就 in the next clause: 只要…就… ('as long as…, then…').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
examples.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuī. Used for wind blowing or blowing on hot tea.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 晚上院子里吹着凉风。
examples.trans: A cool breeze blows through the courtyard in the evening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.en: on the floor; on the ground
meanings.note: Pinyin: dì shang. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地上 ('a patch of floor').

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: 小心，刚拖过的地上还有点湿。
examples.trans: Careful—the freshly mopped floor is still a little damp.

related.gloss: a patch of floor (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú. Combines 地 ('earth/land') + 图 ('chart/drawing'); measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 幅 (fú).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 小晴在手绘地图上用红笔标出了过桥以后的绿药店。
examples.trans: On the hand-drawn map, Qing marked the green pharmacy past the bridge in red pen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì fang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个地方 ('a place').

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà gē. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个家 ('a home').

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xiǎo. Reduplication of 小 ('small'); adds a vivid, affectionate nuance ('tiny little').

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 每个小玻璃瓶里都插着一片小小的绿柠檬叶。
examples.trans: A tiny green lemon leaf is tucked inside each small glass jar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiānduān. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 针的尖端非常锐利。
examples.trans: The point of the needle is extremely sharp.

examples.text: 他们掌握了世界上最尖端的技术。
examples.trans: They have mastered the most cutting-edge technology in the world.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà. Tells minutes 'to' the hour (差五分十二点 'five to twelve') or 'not short a cent' (一分不差).

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guáng chǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个广场 ('a public square').

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

examples.text: 早上有不少老人在小广场散步。
examples.trans: Plenty of seniors stroll around the small square in the morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐzuò. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 雕像的底座是大理石做的。
examples.trans: The base of the statue is made of marble.

examples.text: 请把台灯固定在底座上。
examples.trans: Please fix the desk lamp onto its base.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐng zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 道 (dào).

examples.text: 夕阳把竹子的影子投在白墙上。
examples.trans: The setting sun casts the bamboo's shadow onto the white wall.

examples.text: 灯光下，我看见琴盖后面有一个白纸影子。
examples.trans: Under the lamplight, I spotted the shadow of white paper behind the piano lid.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái tóu. Separable verb-object compound; opposite of 低头.

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng mén. Compound 拱 ('arch') + 门 ('door/gate'). Measure word: 道 (dào) or 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 志豪在速写本上画下了院子的石头拱门。
examples.trans: Hao sketched the courtyard's stone archway in his sketchbook.

examples.text: 穿过这道砖拱门，就能看见后面的小花园。
examples.trans: Walk through this brick archway and you can see the little garden behind.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Used for pointing toward a sign, map, or clue (指着).

examples.text: 谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
examples.trans: Neither of them walked away! Hao is pointing at those two chairs right now!

examples.text: 周经理，快看志豪先生用铅笔指的地方！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look where Mr Zhihao is pointing with his pencil!

指针.gloss: needle (of a compass); hand (of a clock)

meanings.en: needle (of a compass); hand (of a clock)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ zhēn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根指针 ('a pointer needle / clock hand').

examples.text: 把指南针平放在木桌上，蓝钢小指针马上稳稳指向北边。
examples.trans: Set the compass flat on the wooden table, and the blued-steel needle points steadily north at once.

examples.text: 大家都抬头盯着市政钟楼上高高的两根大指针。
examples.trans: Everyone looked up at the two tall clock hands high on the municipal clock tower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gù shi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个故事 ('a story').

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

examples.text: 这栋老砖房里有很多温暖的故事。
examples.trans: This old brick house holds many warm stories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo. Used for knocking on doors or pipes clanking.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 旁边位置 ('a spot beside').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星 ('a star').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空能看见很多星。
examples.trans: On a clear night sky you can see many stars.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.en: someone; somebody; there is someone who
meanings.note: Pronounced yǒurén; existential-indefinite expression introducing an unspecified person as the agent of the following verb, or indicating that a room/seat is occupied.

examples.text: 尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu cannot come to our side; obviously someone leaked the news.

examples.text: 要不是有人爆了照片，我估计两天都撑不住。
examples.trans: Had someone not leaked that photo, I reckon it would not have lasted two days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīngliáng.

examples.text: 夏天的夜晚有一阵清凉的风。
examples.trans: There is a cool breeze on the summer night.

examples.text: 喝一杯冰水感觉非常清凉。
examples.trans: Drinking a glass of ice water feels very refreshing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Single-character bound/free noun for small boxes (木盒 'wooden box', 盒子 'box'); also a measure word ('a box of').

examples.text: 雪松木盒里整齐地放着一叠旧明信片。
examples.trans: A stack of old postcards sits neatly inside the cedar box.

examples.text: 小晴买了一盒彩色粉笔写咖啡馆黑板。
examples.trans: Qing bought a box of coloured chalk to write on the café blackboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì jiào. Separable verb-object compound 睡 ('sleep') + 觉 (jiào, 'a sleep/nap', NOT jué 'feel').

examples.text: 小晴，去睡觉以前先把那两个白罐子贴上标签吧。
examples.trans: Qing, before going to bed, stick labels on those two white jars first.

examples.text: 危机解除了，大家快回房间睡觉——明天早上六点还要进厨房呢！
examples.trans: Crisis averted—everyone head to bed quickly, because the six-o'clock kitchen shift comes early tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块石头 ('a stone').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn. Combines 石 ('stone') + 板 ('slab/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 雨后的院子石板路干干净净，映着温暖的灯光。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard flagstone path is spotless and reflects the warm lamplight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng dào. Resultative verb compound 碰 ('touch/bump') + 到 ('reach/contact').

examples.text: 周经理得意地说：“看，我的白衬衫完全没碰到湿油漆！”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou said proudly, 'Look, my white shirt didn't touch the wet paint at all!'

examples.text: 搬折叠椅进门的时候慢一点，小心别碰到刚刷好的绿窗框。
examples.trans: Go slowly when carrying the folding chairs through the door so you don't bump the freshly painted green window frames.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuānguò.

examples.text: 火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。
examples.trans: The train passed through a long tunnel.

examples.text: 我们必须穿过这片森林才能到达目的地。
examples.trans: We must go through this forest to reach our destination.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箭头 ('an arrow').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 跟着地上的箭头走，就能找到前台。
examples.trans: Follow the arrows on the floor and you will find the front desk.

meanings.note: Noun xiànsuǒ ('investigative lead').

examples.text: 是你们自己走漏了风声，才让我有了线索。
examples.trans: Your own leak was what gave me the lead.

examples.text: 记者顺着这条小线索查清了来龙去脉。
examples.trans: Following that small lead, the reporter pieced it together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kěn dìng. Colloquial cousin of 一定 for confident predictions.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

examples.text: 我也不能让父母的事情曝光在大众的视线里面，我必须得保护他。
examples.trans: Nor can I let their private pain be exposed to the public eye — I have to protect him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 信封右上角贴着一张邮票。
examples.trans: A stamp is stuck on the upper-right corner of the envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.en: to work under; to shadow or apprentice with
meanings.note: gēnzhe — 跟 + durative aspect particle 着; idiomatic in professional settings for working on a mentor's or boss's team
indicates accompanying someone physically or acting immediately in sequence

examples.text: 跟着我，肯定是上十二歌王了。
examples.trans: Working under me, it will definitely be on Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lùdēng. Measure word: 盏.

examples.text: 天黑了，路灯都亮了起来。
examples.trans: It got dark, and all the streetlights came on.

examples.text: 他一个人走在昏暗的路灯下。
examples.trans: He walked alone under the dim streetlights.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò qù. Directional compound moving across toward another spot.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座钟 ('a clock').

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

examples.text: 大堂墙上的老钟敲了十二下。
examples.trans: The old clock on the lobby wall struck twelve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng lóu. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座钟楼 ('a clock tower').

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 老广场北边的石钟楼每到整点都会敲钟。
examples.trans: The stone clock tower north of the plaza chimes every hour on the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铁 ('a piece of iron').

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

related.gloss: a piece of iron (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铜 ('a piece of brass').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

related.gloss: a piece of brass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng. Read cháng when meaning 'long' (又长又正式), and zhǎng when meaning 'grow' (长得高).

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

meanings.note: Noun duìwu ('crew, organized group').

examples.text: 我们有一百三十个人的后台队伍。
examples.trans: We have a 130-person backstage crew.

examples.text: 观众排起了整齐的队伍。
examples.trans: Viewers lined up in an orderly queue.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn zhe. Preposition 顺 ('follow along in the same direction') + continuous particle 着 (顺着走廊吹 'blow down the hallway', 顺着木纹刷 'brush along the wood grain').

examples.text: 小晴顺着木纹薄薄地刷油漆，刷出来的窗板又平整又漂亮。
examples.trans: Qing brushed the paint thinly along the wood grain, giving the shutters a smooth, even finish.

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷的青石板路一直往前走，就能看见九号房的木牌。
examples.trans: Walk straight along the flagstones of Wutong Lane and you will spot the wooden sign for Room Nine.

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo gāo. Reduplication of 高 ('high') for emphasis.

examples.text: 周经理高高地举起那个旧信封，对着光看里面的内容。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou held the old envelope high up, looking at its contents against the light.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的尽头，高高地矗立着一座古老的钟楼。
examples.trans: At the end of Wutong Lane, an ancient clock tower stands towering.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi. Describes black color or no light; 灯黑了 means the lights went out.

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 天黑了，我们回去吧。
examples.trans: It's getting dark; let's head back.
